name: Scenelith
original_description: Create and edit images, generate videos from your references, and work with saved media in Scenelith. Browse your Library, reuse character references, explore supported models, and retrieve original results. Connect your Scenelith account and choose the workspace and permissions you want to share. Available actions depend on the access you approve.
